title: Make My Photo Look Professional
tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The busy kitchen background remains essentially unchanged, including cabinets, appliances, and countertop clutter.
Facial lighting remains bright and uneven, with prominent forehead and nose highlights rather than a clearly softened professional lighting treatment.

judge.summary: The man remains recognizable and is convincingly dressed in a blazer and collared shirt, but the unchanged kitchen and harsh facial highlights prevent a polished professional portrait.

must_haves.item: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
must_haves.why: His facial features are retained, and his short grey hair is neatly restyled.

must_haves.item: His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
must_haves.why: The T-shirt is replaced by a white collared shirt and dark blazer.

must_haves.item: The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
must_haves.why: The kitchen remains clearly visible and detailed, with no meaningful simplification.

must_haves.item: Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
must_haves.why: Skin texture remains realistic, but the strong facial highlights and lighting contrast are not noticeably softened.

must_haves.item: The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.
must_haves.why: The head-and-shoulders framing is intact, and the clothing and hair edits show no obvious seams or anatomical distortions.
